content:
Claude is upgrading its Chrome sidebar into full Cowork sessions, allowing browser tasks and conversations to seamlessly continue across users' other Claude apps.

Claude can now take browser tasks to all apps

Anthropic announced the change today. Conversations initiated in the sidebar are now saved to the Claude conversation history, where users can pick them up from the Claude desktop, web, and mobile apps.

Skills and connectors configured in the account are now available in the browser without additional setup. Claude in Chrome can read the current page content and perform actions through the user's existing browser login sessions, including clicking links, switching pages, typing text, and filling out forms.

Anthropic's example is a user asking Claude to gather invoice data from multiple vendor platforms, build a spreadsheet, and then continue the same session on desktop to add local files or compare results with past budgets.

This update fills a gap in Claude's browser workflow. Previously, sidebar sessions were completely isolated from conversations in Claude's other apps, with no way to share conversation content or context.

Anthropic has also recently shown Claude Code's in-app browser, which uses a separate profile. The Chrome extension, by contrast, works on sites where users are already logged in.

Anthropic warns that browser agents remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks.

An additional review mechanism will target high-impact actions when auto-approval is enabled, while actions involving purchases or sharing personal data will still require user consent.

The company says these safeguards reduce but do not completely eliminate the risks.

Availability

The Cowork sidebar is available starting today for Max and Team customers, with Pro users expected to roll out over the coming weeks. Enterprise administrators can enable the feature and restrict access to approved domains. Claude in Chrome does not currently support other Chromium browsers or mobile devices.

This release continues Anthropic's push to make Claude workflows seamlessly portable across platforms.

Recent additions include real-time testing for Claude Code for Mac on iOS apps, and new Opus 4.8 controls for running longer jobs on more products and devices.
